name: Eastern Institute of Technology
description: Eastern Institute of Technology (EIT) is a polytechnic, not a university, based in Napier with campuses in Gisborne and Auckland, and it awards its own bachelor's and master's degrees. It was part of Te Pūkenga, the national polytechnic network, from 2020 until it became a stand-alone polytechnic again on 1 January 2026.
whyIncluded: One of the 10 universities in New Zealand most popular with international students; New Zealand is one of the nine places Singaporeans most often study abroad (about 360 Singaporean students, UNESCO data).

livingCosts.summary: EIT publishes no living-cost budget, so this is Immigration New Zealand's student-visa living-cost minimum of NZ$20,000 a year (about NZ$1,667 a month), split into rent, food, transport and personal using the pattern of other New Zealand universities.
livingCosts.notes: Rung C. Tried for rung A/B: eit.ac.nz International FAQs (no amounts; refers to Immigration NZ), Application Guide, 'Life in Napier' page, Student Handbook, 2027 international Programme Matrix PDF and a programme information PDF (tuition only; 'tuition fees do not include any insurances, Student Services Fee or any additional course-related costs'); the /international/living-in-new-zealand/ URL returns 404. The only EIT price found is the Napier Student Village single furnished room at NZ$190/week including electricity and internet (about NZ$823/month), which is below the housing figure below and supports it as a conservative budget. Figure used: Immigration New Zealand 'Student fund requirements' page, read 2026-10-08: 'NZD $20,000 for each year, if you are studying for 1 year or more' (NZD $1,667 per month for shorter courses). Monthly = 20,000 / 12 = 1,666.67, split with the brief's New Zealand average shares housing .71 / food .14 / transport .04 / personal .11. Excludes tuition, the compulsory medical and travel insurance, flights and visa fees. Rechecked 2026-10-13: EIT 'Study in New Zealand as an International Student' page gives no living-cost figures.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Computing Systems
programmes.summary: Standard yearly tuition for international students for 2027, including GST. Excludes the student services fee and insurance.
programmes.notes: 2027 standard fee per academic year, Napier ('undergraduate tuition fees listed are for one academic year only'); net fee after scholarship $24,500. 3 years. Source: EIT '2027 Programme - Dates and Fees' international matrix (PDF, undated; fees incl. GST; 'tuition fees do not include any insurances, Student Services Fee or any additional course-related costs'). The Student Services Fee amount was not found on EIT pages, so compulsory fees are 0 (understated). Standard fee recorded; 'Net Fees' are after an EIT scholarship. No 2024-2026 figures found. No year-labelled 2024-2026 agent fee list or earlier EIT fee matrix was found either (2026-10-13; studywithnewzealand course pages carry no fees). 2024 row (2026-10-13, official): EIT's '2024 version 2 EIT International Prospectus' PDF ('The tuition fees listed are for all 2024 programmes'; annual, incl. GST) lists Bachelor of Computing Systems at $25,000 a year (single fee, no net/standard split for undergraduates). It also gives a Student Services Levy of $364 for 2024, not added so the row matches the 2027 basis. Round 4 (2026-10-13): EIT's linked International Prospectus (English and Mandarin) are now the 2027 editions, the 2026 prospectus is domestic-only with no fees, and the programme app packs now show 2027, so no 2025/2026 source was found. Round 5 (2026-10-13): no 2025/2026 source found. EIT's WordPress media API (wp-json/wp/v2/media search) lists the 2024 'EIT-International-Programme-Matrix.pdf' (2024 fees only) and the 2025/2026 international prospectus cover images, but not the 2025/2026 prospectus or matrix PDFs; guessed file names under programme-app-packs and wp-content/uploads returned 404, all current international app packs now say 2027 (only the BN pack is 2026), and 2026 Council board packs give fee revenue only. Round 6 (2026-10-13): still no 2025/2026 row. The international prospectus page links only fixed 'programme-app-packs' file names that are overwritten each year (now 2027); a full media-library search found only 2026 app packs for other programmes (e.g. Sport and Exercise Science 2026 $26,000) and the 2024 matrix; 2025/2026 prospectus file-name guesses across late-2024 to early-2026 upload folders all 404; agent pages (canamgroup, aecoverseas, unischolars NZ$21,100) give undated figures. Round 7 (2026-10-13, Common Crawl captures of official pages): 2025 annual fee, Napier; the 2025 prospectus shows a single fee (no standard/net split). Compulsory left 0 as in existing rows (levy not added). 2026 standard fee per year, Napier, same basis as 2027 (net $24,500 after scholarship). 2026 Student Services Levy $402 not added, matching existing rows.

If you need to study for more than one year to complete your qualification, your fees in the second year, and subsequent years, will not be known when you first enrol', so the fee is not guaranteed for the duration and the calculator's yearly increase on the second year stands.
